step1_analysis.description: This circuit is the active core of an LC-VCO used for GFSK modulation. It features a cross-coupled NMOS pair (XM2, XM3) to provide negative resistance, a tail current mirror (XM1, XM4), and two NMOS transistors (XM6, XM7) acting as accumulation-mode varactors for frequency tuning (VCON) and direct modulation (VMOD).

paper_reference.title: A 1.8-V Operation RF CMOS Transceiver for 2.4-GHz-Band GFSK Applications

sky130_expected.calculation: f = 1 / (2*pi*sqrt(L*C)). With an added ideal tank of L_diff=4nH and C_diff=1pF, plus varactor and parasitic capacitances (~0.05pF).
sky130_expected.reasoning: The ideal tank is sized to target the 2.4 GHz ISM band specified in the paper.

P_dc.description: DC power consumption of the VCO core.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = I_tail * VDD. I_tail is mirrored from XM4. With VIBIAS6=0.54V and Vth~0.42V, Vov=0.12V. I_tail ~ 0.5 * 270u * 10 * 0.12^2 = ~20uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on the provided 0.54V bias voltage and SKY130 NMOS parameters.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by tail current and tank equivalent parallel resistance, limited by VDD and varactor forward-biasing.
sky130_expected.reasoning: With an ideal LC tank, the swing can exceed VDD but will be clipped when the varactors or cross-coupled pair enter the linear region.

Kvco.description: VCO tuning sensitivity (change in frequency per volt of VCON).

sky130_expected.reasoning: As VCON increases, the varactor depletion region shrinks, increasing capacitance and lowering the frequency.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure VCO oscillation frequency, power consumption, output swing, and tuning sensitivity (Kvco). An ideal LC tank is added to enable oscillation at 2.4 GHz.
step3_testbench.spice:
* VCO Active Core Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

* DUT
XM6 N2 VCON N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N2 VMOD N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM2 N2 N3 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N3 N2 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM1 N4 IBIAS6 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM4 IBIAS6 IBIAS6 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

* Ideal LC Tank for 2.4 GHz
L1 N2 VDD 2n
L2 N3 VDD 2n
C1 N2 N3 1p

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VIBIAS6 IBIAS6 0 0.54
VVCON VCON 0 0.9
VVMOD VMOD 0 0.9

* Initial condition to kickstart oscillation
.ic v(N2)=1.8 v(N3)=1.7

.control
  * 1. Measure DC Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * 2. Transient Analysis for f_osc and Vpp at VCON = 0.9V
  tran 10p 20n uic
  
  * Measure frequency over the 30th cycle to ensure steady state
  meas tran t1 trig v(N2) val=1.8 rise=30
  meas tran t2 trig v(N2) val=1.8 rise=31
  let f_osc1 = 1 / (t2 - t1)
  print f_osc1
  
  * Measure peak-to-peak voltage
  meas tran vmax max v(N2) from=10n to=20n
  meas tran vmin min v(N2) from=10n to=20n
  let vpp = vmax - vmin
  print vpp

  * 3. Transient Analysis for Kvco at VCON = 1.8V
  alter VVCON 1.8
  tran 10p 20n uic
  
  meas tran t3 trig v(N2) val=1.8 rise=30
  meas tran t4 trig v(N2) val=1.8 rise=31
  let f_osc2 = 1 / (t4 - t3)
  print f_osc2
  
  * Calculate tuning sensitivity
  let kvco = (f_osc2 - f_osc1) / 0.9
  print kvco
  
  quit
.endc
.end
